## 475. When holding for a reading stands above a route of keeping (RR2)

Board item RR2, the routes of keeping and holding for a reading on one order ([note §10](../../development/rr-revision-routes/NOTE.md#10-the-join-routes-of-keeping-and-holding-for-a-reading-one-order-rr2)). An independent cross-model reader reviewed the first draft and found one blocker: the general law sat beside RF-M.2's balances instead of below them. The module was rewritten as the lower one, and the same reader re-checked it. HeldForReading's owner then asked that its thresholds, the amounts holding for the reading may forgo and its ties come from the new module too, and that `Plan` be renamed where three modules already use the name; both were done, and `HeldForReading` and RF-M.3's `forgone_lt_iff` now take those laws from it, a change its owner reviewed ([the review](../../development/rr-revision-routes/REVIEW.md#rr2-the-independent-review-of-the-join-and-its-re-check)).
